Bending Spoons is acquiring Airtable for $2.25B
Airtable has $965M of cash, so the EV is $1.285B.
Airtable had raised $1.35B of VC capital, last round Dec ‘21 at $11.7B.
At ~$480M ARR growing 20%+ YoY, that’s 2.7x ARR.
Surprised they are selling with…

gholam.text: داش، شرکت Bending Spoons اومده Airtable رو کلاً با ۲.۲۵ میلیارد دلار خریده، در حالی که قبلاً ۱۱.۷ میلیارد دلار می‌ارزید! عجیبه خدایی، با داشتن نزدیک یک میلیارد دلار پول نقد تو جیبشون، معلوم نیست چرا انقدر ارزون فروختن رفت.

links.text:
Bending Spoons is acquiring Airtable for $2.25B

Airtable has $965M of cash, so the EV is $1.285B. 

Airtable had raised $1.35B of VC capital, last round Dec ‘21 at $11.7B.

At ~$480M ARR growing 20%+ YoY, that’s 2.7x ARR.

Surprised they are selling with so much cash!

quote.text: We've officially agreed to acquire Airtable for $1.285B! 😍
